target: annualized realized variance of future BTC-PERPETUAL log returns
availability: daily candle close available at interval timestamp plus one day

bias_correction.method: expanding ratio of completed target variance to forecast variance

evaluation.model_comparison: Diebold-Mariano on non-overlapping QLIKE loss differentials with Student-t inference

signal_policy.long: corrected GARCH variance > mean ask-IV variance
signal_policy.short: corrected GARCH variance < mean bid-IV variance
signal_policy.flat: forecast variance inside bid/ask IV boundaries
